name: Time Quest For Fudgers
source:
Austin can finally afford a trip back to the past, thanks to consumer-grade time travel technology.  So he goes to 2012 to get his dying grandmother's favorite candy bar.  Will he be able to retrieve the tasty treat?  That's up to you!  And if you're really lucky, you might just find the true ending!

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/time-quest-for-fudgers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
得益于消费级时间旅行技术，奥斯汀终于可以回到过去了。于是，他来到了2012年，去买他垂死的祖母最喜欢的糖果。他能拿回美味佳肴吗？这取决于你！如果你真的很幸运，你可能会找到真正的结局！

[来自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/time-quest-for-fudgers]itch.io[/url]]
